_comment: Single source of plain text for Intelligence checks (English and Swahili); tested by tests/test_intel_plain.py.

title.en: Cash and sales
title.sw: Pesa na mauzo

lead.en: Money in and out of your tills and payment accounts, and how sales and cashiers are behaving.
lead.sw: Pesa zinazoingia na kutoka kwenye kaunta na akaunti za malipo, na hali ya mauzo na keshia.

title.en: Stock
title.sw: Bidhaa (hisa)

lead.en: Products running out, going missing, expiring or sitting unsold.
lead.sw: Bidhaa zinazoisha, zinazopotea, zinazoisha muda au zinazokaa bila kuuzwa.

title.en: Customers
title.sw: Wateja

lead.en: Customers who owe you, pay late or have too much credit.
lead.sw: Wateja wanaokudai, wanaochelewa kulipa au wenye mkopo mkubwa mno.

title.en: Suppliers
title.sw: Wasambazaji

lead.en: Supplier invoices, payments, prices and orders.
lead.sw: Ankara za wasambazaji, malipo, bei na oda.

title.en: Staff
title.sw: Wafanyakazi

lead.en: Wages, leave, overtime, and who did what in Ziira.
lead.sw: Mishahara, likizo, saa za ziada, na nani alifanya nini kwenye Ziira.

title.en: Your books
title.sw: Hesabu za biashara

lead.en: Entries, expenses, closed months, bank matching and profit margins.
lead.sw: Rekodi za hesabu, matumizi, miezi iliyofungwa, kulinganisha na benki na faida.

above_percent.en: How much above the usual price (in %) before it is flagged
above_percent.sw: Bei ya juu kuliko kawaida kwa asilimia ngapi kabla ya kuonyeshwa

age_days.en: Days old before an unmatched bank line is flagged
age_days.sw: Siku ngapi ndipo mstari wa benki usiolinganishwa uonyeshwe

backdate_days.en: How many days earlier than the entry day counts as back-dated
backdate_days.sw: Siku ngapi kabla ya siku ya kuandikwa ndipo ihesabiwe kuwa imeandikwa kwa tarehe ya nyuma

cost_rise_percent.en: How much the cost must rise (in %)
cost_rise_percent.sw: Gharama lazima ipande kwa asilimia ngapi

days.en: How many days back to look

days_ahead.en: How many days ahead to look for expiry
days_ahead.sw: Siku ngapi mbele za kuangalia kuisha muda

days_apart.en: Days apart that still count as the same invoice
days_apart.sw: Siku ngapi kati yake zinazohesabiwa kuwa ankara ileile

days_back.en: How many days back to look for expired stock
days_back.sw: Siku ngapi nyuma za kutafuta bidhaa zilizoisha muda

days_open.en: Days left unfinished before it is flagged
days_open.sw: Siku ngapi bila kukamilika ndipo ionyeshwe

deviations.en: How many times the usual ups and downs counts as unusual
deviations.sw: Mara ngapi ya mabadiliko ya kawaida ndipo ihesabiwe si ya kawaida

drop_percent.en: How far below normal (in %) counts as a big drop
drop_percent.sw: Kushuka chini ya kawaida kwa asilimia ngapi ni kushuka kukubwa

drop_points.en: How many percentage points the margin must fall
drop_points.sw: Pointi ngapi za asilimia faida inapaswa kushuka

failure_percent.en: Share of requests that failed (in %) before it is flagged
failure_percent.sw: Asilimia ya maombi yaliyoshindwa kabla ya kuonyeshwa

grace_days.en: Days to wait before it counts as a problem
grace_days.sw: Siku za kusubiri kabla ya kuhesabiwa tatizo

grace_hours.en: Hours to wait before it counts as a problem
grace_hours.sw: Saa za kusubiri kabla ya kuhesabiwa tatizo

high_count.en: Number of cases at which it becomes urgent
high_count.sw: Idadi ya visa ambapo inakuwa ya haraka

high_days_late.en: Days late at which it becomes urgent
high_days_late.sw: Siku za kuchelewa ambapo inakuwa ya haraka

high_days_overdue.en: Days overdue at which it becomes urgent
high_days_overdue.sw: Siku za kuchelewa kulipa ambapo inakuwa ya haraka

high_over_pct.en: How far over the credit limit (in %) it becomes urgent
high_over_pct.sw: Kuvuka kikomo cha mkopo kwa asilimia ngapi ndipo iwe ya haraka

high_percent.en: How far over the credit limit (in %) it becomes urgent
high_percent.sw: Kuvuka kikomo cha mkopo kwa asilimia ngapi ndipo iwe ya haraka

history_days.en: How many days of earlier history to compare with
history_days.sw: Siku ngapi za historia ya awali za kulinganisha

hours.en: Hours to wait before it counts as a problem
hours.sw: Saa za kusubiri kabla ya kuhesabiwa tatizo

hours_apart.en: Hours apart that still count as the same payment
hours_apart.sw: Saa ngapi kati yake zinazohesabiwa kuwa malipo yaleyale

increase_percent.en: How much slower (in %) counts as slower
increase_percent.sw: Kuchelewa zaidi kwa asilimia ngapi ndipo ihesabiwe kuchelewa

large_amount.en: Amount above which an entry counts as large
large_amount.sw: Kiasi ambacho kikizidi rekodi ihesabiwe kubwa

late_days.en: Days late before an entry is flagged
late_days.sw: Siku za kuchelewa kabla ya rekodi kuonyeshwa

limit.en: Amount above which it is flagged

lookback_days.en: How many days back to look

manual_only.en: Only look at entries typed in by hand (1 = yes, 0 = no)
manual_only.sw: Angalia rekodi zilizoandikwa kwa mkono tu (1 = ndiyo, 0 = hapana)

many.en: Number of overdue follow-ups at which it becomes urgent
many.sw: Idadi ya ufuatiliaji uliochelewa ambapo inakuwa ya haraka

max_customers.en: Most customers to check in one go
max_customers.sw: Wateja wengi zaidi wa kukagua kwa mara moja

methods.en: Payment types to check (for example mobile money, bank)
methods.sw: Aina za malipo za kukagua (mfano pesa za simu, benki)

min_actions.en: Fewest changes in a day before it is flagged
min_actions.sw: Mabadiliko machache zaidi kwa siku kabla ya kuonyeshwa

min_attempts.en: Fewest requests in a day before it is judged
min_attempts.sw: Maombi machache zaidi kwa siku kabla ya kuhukumiwa

min_day.en: Day of the month from which the margin is judged
min_day.sw: Siku ya mwezi ambapo faida huanza kuhukumiwa

min_days_late.en: Fewest days late before it is flagged
min_days_late.sw: Siku chache zaidi za kuchelewa kabla ya kuonyeshwa

min_days_overdue.en: Days past the due date before a customer is flagged
min_days_overdue.sw: Siku baada ya tarehe ya kulipa kabla mteja kuonyeshwa

min_earlier.en: Fewest earlier records needed to compare with
min_earlier.sw: Rekodi chache zaidi za awali zinazohitajika kulinganisha

min_history.en: Fewest days of history needed to know what is normal
min_history.sw: Siku chache zaidi za historia za kujua hali ya kawaida

min_hours.en: Fewest extra overtime hours worth flagging
min_hours.sw: Saa chache zaidi za ziada zinazostahili kuonyeshwa

min_income.en: Smallest monthly sales before the margin is judged
min_income.sw: Mauzo madogo zaidi ya mwezi kabla ya faida kuhukumiwa

min_increase_days.en: Fewest extra days to pay before flagging
min_increase_days.sw: Siku chache zaidi za kuchelewa kulipa kabla ya kuonyeshwa

min_invoices.en: Fewest invoices needed to judge how a customer pays
min_invoices.sw: Ankara chache zaidi za kuhukumu jinsi mteja anavyolipa

min_items.en: Fewest items before it is flagged
min_items.sw: Vitu vichache zaidi kabla ya kuonyeshwa

min_margin_percent.en: Profit margin (in %) below which it is flagged
min_margin_percent.sw: Faida (asilimia) ikiwa chini ya hii huonyeshwa

min_months.en: Fewest earlier months needed to know what is normal
min_months.sw: Miezi michache zaidi ya awali ya kujua hali ya kawaida

min_override.sw: Punguzo dogo kabisa la bei linalostahili kuonyeshwa

min_quantity.en: Smallest number of units worth flagging
min_quantity.sw: Idadi ndogo kabisa ya vipande inayostahili kuonyeshwa

min_rate.en: Smallest share of sales worth flagging (0.05 means 5 in every 100)
min_rate.sw: Sehemu ndogo kabisa ya mauzo inayostahili kuonyeshwa (0.05 ni 5 kati ya 100)

min_ratio.en: How many times the usual amount counts as unusual
min_ratio.sw: Mara ngapi ya kiasi cha kawaida ndipo ihesabiwe si ya kawaida

min_sales.en: Fewest sales needed before a cashier is judged
min_sales.sw: Mauzo machache zaidi kabla keshia kuhukumiwa

min_samples.en: Fewest earlier days needed to know what is normal
min_samples.sw: Siku chache zaidi za awali za kujua hali ya kawaida

min_void.sw: Mauzo madogo kabisa yaliyofutwa yanayostahili kuonyeshwa

overdue_days.en: Days past due before a supplier invoice is flagged
overdue_days.sw: Siku baada ya tarehe ya kulipa kabla ankara ya msambazaji kuonyeshwa

percent.en: Share (in %) above which it is flagged

recent_days.en: How many recent days to look at
recent_days.sw: Siku ngapi za karibuni za kuangalia

rise_percent.en: How big a price rise (in %) is flagged
rise_percent.sw: Kupanda kwa bei kwa asilimia ngapi ndipo ionyeshwe

round_min.sw: Rekodi ndogo kabisa ya namba ya pande zote inayostahili kuonyeshwa

round_step.en: What counts as a round figure (for example a multiple of 10,000)
round_step.sw: Nini kinahesabiwa namba ya pande zote (mfano mara 10,000)

round_unit.en: What counts as a round figure (for example a multiple of 1,000)
round_unit.sw: Nini kinahesabiwa namba ya pande zote (mfano mara 1,000)

serious_days.en: Days past due at which it becomes urgent
serious_days.sw: Siku baada ya tarehe ya kulipa ambapo inakuwa ya haraka

tolerance_percent.en: How big a difference (in %) is allowed before flagging
tolerance_percent.sw: Tofauti ya asilimia ngapi inaruhusiwa kabla ya kuonyeshwa

unmatched_days.en: Days a payment may stay unmatched before it is flagged
unmatched_days.sw: Siku ngapi malipo yanaweza kukaa bila kulinganishwa kabla ya kuonyeshwa

urgent_days.en: Days left at which it becomes urgent
urgent_days.sw: Siku zilizobaki ambapo inakuwa ya haraka

usage_pct.en: Share of colleagues with attendance records (in %) before it is flagged
usage_pct.sw: Asilimia ya wenzake wenye rekodi za kuhudhuria kabla ya kuonyeshwa

value_limit.en: Value above which it is flagged

variance_limit.en: Difference in money above which it is flagged

waiting_days.en: Days waiting before it is flagged
waiting_days.sw: Siku za kusubiri kabla ya kuonyeshwa

window_days.en: How many days of history to compare
window_days.sw: Siku ngapi za historia za kulinganisha

window_minutes.en: How many minutes apart still counts as the same event
window_minutes.sw: Dakika ngapi kati yake zinazohesabiwa kuwa tukio lilelile

within_days.en: How many days apart counts as close together
within_days.sw: Siku ngapi kati yake zinazohesabiwa kuwa karibu

label.en: Days without a sale or move

title.en: Many changes made at odd hours
title.sw: Mabadiliko mengi yamefanywa saa zisizo za kawaida

why.en: Work done late at night or very early may be a mistake, or someone using another person's login.
why.sw: Kazi ya usiku sana au alfajiri inaweza kuwa kosa, au mtu anatumia jina la mwingine kuingia.

todo.en: Ask the person if it was them and why. Change their password if it was not.
todo.sw: Muulize mhusika kama ni yeye na kwa nini. Kama si yeye, mbadilishie nenosiri.

sentence.en: Tell me when someone makes {min_actions} or more changes outside {start_hour}:00 to {end_hour}:00.
sentence.sw: Niambie mtu akifanya mabadiliko {min_actions} au zaidi nje ya saa {start_hour}:00 hadi {end_hour}:00.

title.en: Someone approved their own request
title.sw: Mtu ameidhinisha ombi lake mwenyewe

why.en: When one person asks and approves, nobody else has looked, so a mistake or misuse can slip through.
why.sw: Mtu mmoja akiomba na kuidhinisha, hakuna mwingine aliyeangalia, hivyo kosa linaweza kupita.

todo.en: Look at what was approved. Ask someone else to review it.
todo.sw: Angalia kilichoidhinishwa. Mwombe mtu mwingine akipitie.

sentence.en: Look at approvals from the last {days} days.
sentence.sw: Angalia idhini za siku {days} zilizopita.

title.en: Problems in the inbox nobody has looked at
title.sw: Matatizo kwenye kikasha ambayo hakuna aliyeyaangalia

why.en: Problems Ziira could not finish by itself keep piling up and may hold up sales or stock.
why.sw: Matatizo ambayo Ziira haikuweza kuyamaliza yanazidi kurundikana na yanaweza kuchelewesha mauzo au hisa.

todo.en: Open the exceptions inbox and clear the oldest items first.
todo.sw: Fungua kikasha cha matatizo na ushughulikie ya zamani zaidi kwanza.

sentence.en: Tell me when {min_items} or more items have waited {days} days.
sentence.sw: Niambie vitu {min_items} au zaidi vikisubiri siku {days}.

title.en: Someone was given wide access
title.sw: Mtu amepewa ruhusa pana

why.en: A person who can act across the whole business can see and change a lot, so it should be on purpose.
why.sw: Mtu anayeweza kufanya kazi kwenye biashara nzima anaweza kuona na kubadilisha mengi, kwa hiyo iwe kwa makusudi.

todo.en: Confirm the person needs this access. Reduce it if they do not.
todo.sw: Hakikisha mtu huyo anahitaji ruhusa hii. Ipunguze kama hahitaji.

sentence.en: Tell me about wide access given in the last {days} days.
sentence.sw: Niambie kuhusu ruhusa pana zilizotolewa siku {days} zilizopita.

title.en: A credit limit increase is waiting for approval
title.sw: Ombi la kuongeza mkopo wa mteja linasubiri idhini

why.en: The customer may be held up or sold to anyway, while the request sits unanswered.
why.sw: Mteja anaweza kuchelewa kuhudumiwa au kuuziwa hata hivyo, huku ombi halijajibiwa.

todo.en: Approve or decline the request, then tell the customer.
todo.sw: Idhinisha au kataa ombi, kisha mjulishe mteja.

sentence.en: Tell me when a request has waited more than {days} days.
sentence.sw: Niambie ombi likisubiri zaidi ya siku {days}.

title.en: Two customers share a phone or tax number
title.sw: Wateja wawili wana namba ya simu au ya kodi ileile

why.en: One person with two accounts can end up with more credit than you meant to give.
why.sw: Mtu mmoja mwenye akaunti mbili anaweza kupata mkopo mkubwa kuliko ulivyokusudia.

todo.en: Open both accounts. Merge them, or fix the number if it is a mistake.
todo.sw: Fungua akaunti zote mbili. Ziunganishe, au sahihisha namba kama ni kosa.

sentence.en: Look at customers added in the last {days} days.
sentence.sw: Angalia wateja walioongezwa siku {days} zilizopita.

title.en: Follow-ups with possible customers are overdue
title.sw: Kuwafuatilia wateja watarajiwa kumechelewa

why.en: Sales you could win are going cold because nobody called back.
why.sw: Mauzo ambayo ungeweza kupata yanapoa kwa sababu hakuna aliyepiga simu tena.

todo.en: Ask the salesperson to call these people, or give the work to someone else.
todo.sw: Mwombe muuzaji awapigie watu hawa simu, au mpe mtu mwingine kazi hiyo.

sentence.en: Tell me when someone has {many} or more follow-ups late by {days} days.
sentence.sw: Niambie mtu akiwa na ufuatiliaji {many} au zaidi uliochelewa kwa siku {days}.

title.en: A customer is over their credit limit
title.sw: Mteja amevuka kikomo cha mkopo wake

why.en: The more a customer owes beyond their limit, the harder it is to get the money back.
why.sw: Kadiri mteja anavyodaiwa kupita kikomo, ndivyo inavyokuwa vigumu kurudisha pesa.

todo.en: Ask the customer to pay something before selling more on credit.
todo.sw: Mwombe mteja alipe kiasi fulani kabla ya kumuuzia tena kwa mkopo.

sentence.en: Make it urgent when a customer is {high_over_pct}% over their limit.
sentence.sw: Iwe ya haraka mteja akivuka kikomo kwa {high_over_pct}%.

title.en: Entries were made long after their date
title.sw: Rekodi ziliandikwa muda mrefu baada ya tarehe yake

why.en: Changing the past after the fact can alter reports you already used.
why.sw: Kubadilisha yaliyopita baadaye kunaweza kubadilisha ripoti ulizokwisha kutumia.

todo.en: Ask who made the entry and why. Check the reports for that date.
todo.sw: Uliza nani aliandika na kwa nini. Angalia ripoti za tarehe hiyo.

sentence.en: Tell me when an entry is made more than {late_days} days after its date.
sentence.sw: Niambie rekodi ikiandikwa zaidi ya siku {late_days} baada ya tarehe yake.

title.en: A large hand-made entry in your books
title.sw: Rekodi kubwa iliandikwa kwenye hesabu kwa mkono

why.en: Hand-made entries skip the normal checks, so large ones deserve a second look.
why.sw: Rekodi za mkono hazipitii ukaguzi wa kawaida, kwa hiyo kubwa zinastahili kuangaliwa tena.

todo.en: Open the entry and check the reason and the papers behind it.
todo.sw: Fungua rekodi na uangalie sababu na nyaraka zake.

sentence.en: Tell me when a hand-made entry is bigger than {limit}.
sentence.sw: Niambie rekodi ya mkono ikizidi {limit}.

title.en: You are keeping less profit from each sale
title.sw: Unabaki na faida ndogo kwenye kila mauzo

why.en: If the cost of goods rises faster than prices, you earn less on every sale.
why.sw: Gharama ya bidhaa ikipanda kuliko bei, unapata kidogo kwenye kila mauzo.

todo.en: Check recent supplier prices and your selling prices.
todo.sw: Angalia bei za wasambazaji za karibuni na bei zako za kuuza.

sentence.en: Tell me when the margin falls by {drop_points} points below normal.
sentence.sw: Niambie faida ikishuka pointi {drop_points} chini ya kawaida.

title.en: A hand-made entry was made late at night
title.sw: Rekodi ya mkono iliandikwa usiku sana

why.en: Entries made when nobody is around are harder to explain and may be mistakes.
why.sw: Rekodi zinazoandikwa wakati hakuna mtu ni ngumu kuelezwa na zinaweza kuwa makosa.

todo.en: Ask who made it and check the reason given.
todo.sw: Uliza nani aliiandika na uangalie sababu iliyotolewa.

sentence.en: Tell me about hand-made entries made before {end_hour}:00 or after {start_hour}:00.
sentence.sw: Niambie kuhusu rekodi za mkono zilizoandikwa kabla ya saa {end_hour}:00 au baada ya saa {start_hour}:00.

title.en: A closed month was opened again
title.sw: Mwezi uliofungwa umefunguliwa tena

why.en: Figures you already relied on for that month can now change.
why.sw: Namba ulizokwisha kutegemea za mwezi huo sasa zinaweza kubadilika.

todo.en: Ask who reopened it and why. Close the month again when done.
todo.sw: Uliza nani aliufungua na kwa nini. Ufunge tena baada ya kumaliza.

sentence.en: Look at months reopened in the last {days} days.
sentence.sw: Angalia miezi iliyofunguliwa tena siku {days} zilizopita.

title.en: Something was added to a month already closed
title.sw: Kitu kimeongezwa kwenye mwezi uliokwisha kufungwa

why.en: A closed month should not change, or your reports no longer match what you were told.
why.sw: Mwezi uliofungwa haupaswi kubadilika, la sivyo ripoti hazilingani na ulichoambiwa.

todo.en: Look at the entry and ask why it was added after closing.
todo.sw: Angalia rekodi na uulize kwa nini iliongezwa baada ya kufunga.

sentence.en: Look at entries from the last {days} days.
sentence.sw: Angalia rekodi za siku {days} zilizopita.

title.en: A hand-made entry has a perfectly round amount
title.sw: Rekodi ya mkono ina kiasi cha namba ya pande zote

why.en: Real transactions are rarely perfectly round, so it may be an estimate or a mistake.
why.sw: Miamala halisi huwa mara chache kamili ya pande zote, kwa hiyo inaweza kuwa makadirio au kosa.

todo.en: Ask what the entry is for and ask to see the papers.
todo.sw: Uliza rekodi ni ya nini na uombe kuona nyaraka.

sentence.en: Tell me about round hand-made entries of {min_amount} or more.
sentence.sw: Niambie kuhusu rekodi za mkono za namba ya pande zote za {min_amount} au zaidi.

title.en: One person wrote and approved the same entry
title.sw: Mtu mmoja ameandika na kuidhinisha rekodi ileile

why.en: Nobody else checked it, so a mistake or misuse would not be caught.
why.sw: Hakuna mwingine aliyeikagua, kwa hiyo kosa au matumizi mabaya yasingegunduliwa.

todo.en: Ask a second person to review the entry.
todo.sw: Mwombe mtu wa pili akague rekodi hiyo.

sentence.en: Look at entries from the last {days} days.
sentence.sw: Angalia rekodi za siku {days} zilizopita.

title.en: Matching your bank statement was never finished
title.sw: Kulinganisha na taarifa ya benki hakukukamilika

why.en: Until it is finished you cannot be sure the bank and your books agree.
why.sw: Hadi ikamilike huwezi kuwa na uhakika benki na hesabu zako zinakubaliana.

todo.en: Open it and finish matching, or cancel it if it was started by mistake.
todo.sw: Ifungue na umalize kulinganisha, au ifute kama ilianzishwa kwa makosa.

sentence.en: Tell me when it has stayed open more than {days_open} days.
sentence.sw: Niambie ikikaa wazi zaidi ya siku {days_open}.

title.en: Old money movements not matched to your bank statement
title.sw: Miamala ya zamani haijalinganishwa na taarifa ya benki

why.en: Unmatched money can hide missing payments or mistakes.
why.sw: Pesa zisizolinganishwa zinaweza kuficha malipo yanayokosekana au makosa.

todo.en: Match them against the bank statement and find out any that do not appear.
todo.sw: Zilinganishe na taarifa ya benki na ufuatilie zisizoonekana.

sentence.en: Tell me when a line is older than {age_days} days and still not matched.
sentence.sw: Niambie mstari ukiwa na zaidi ya siku {age_days} na bado haujalinganishwa.

title.en: A branch spent far more than usual
title.sw: Tawi limetumia zaidi kuliko kawaida kwenye tumizi moja

why.en: A big one-off cost can be a mistake, a double entry or something to question.
why.sw: Gharama kubwa ya mara moja inaweza kuwa kosa, rekodi mara mbili au kitu cha kuulizia.

todo.en: Check the receipt and ask the branch what it was for.
todo.sw: Angalia risiti na uulize tawi ilikuwa ya nini.

sentence.en: Tell me when an expense is at least {min_ratio} times the usual and over {min_amount}.
sentence.sw: Niambie tumizi likiwa mara {min_ratio} ya kawaida au zaidi na juu ya {min_amount}.

title.en: One person removed a lot of stock by hand
title.sw: Mtu mmoja ameondoa hisa nyingi kwa mkono

why.en: Large write-offs by one person may be a mistake or stock leaving without a sale.
why.sw: Hasara kubwa kutoka kwa mtu mmoja inaweza kuwa kosa au bidhaa kutoka bila mauzo.

todo.en: Ask the person why, and check the stock on the shelf.
todo.sw: Muulize mhusika kwa nini, na uangalie bidhaa zilizopo kwenye rafu.

sentence.en: Tell me when someone writes off more than {min_value} of stock in a day.
sentence.sw: Niambie mtu akiondoa hisa ya zaidi ya {min_value} kwa siku.

title.en: Expired stock is still on your records
title.sw: Bidhaa zilizoisha muda bado zimo kwenye rekodi

why.en: Expired goods cannot be sold safely, and your stock value is overstated.
why.sw: Bidhaa zilizoisha muda haziuzwi kwa usalama, na thamani ya hisa yako imezidishwa.

todo.en: Remove them from the shelf and write them off with a reason.
todo.sw: Ziondoe kwenye rafu na uziandike kama hasara pamoja na sababu.

sentence.en: Look back {days_back} days for expired stock.
sentence.sw: Angalia nyuma siku {days_back} kutafuta bidhaa zilizoisha muda.

title.en: Some stock will expire soon
title.sw: Baadhi ya bidhaa zitaisha muda hivi karibuni

why.en: Goods that expire before they sell turn into a loss.
why.sw: Bidhaa zinazoisha muda kabla ya kuuzwa huwa hasara.

todo.en: Sell these first. Think about a discount or moving them to a busier branch.
todo.sw: Ziuze kwanza. Fikiria punguzo au kuzihamishia tawi lenye wateja wengi.

sentence.en: Warn me {days_ahead} days before stock expires, and urgently at {urgent_days} days.
sentence.sw: Nionye siku {days_ahead} kabla bidhaa kuisha muda, na kwa haraka siku {urgent_days}.

title.en: A stock count was far off the records
title.sw: Hesabu ya hisa imekuta zaidi au pungufu sana ya kinachotarajiwa

why.en: Big differences mean stock is going missing, or records are wrong.
why.sw: Tofauti kubwa humaanisha bidhaa zinapotea, au rekodi si sahihi.

todo.en: Count the products again and find the cause before you correct the records.
todo.sw: Hesabu bidhaa tena na ujue sababu kabla ya kusahihisha rekodi.

sentence.en: Tell me when a count is out by more than {value_limit}.
sentence.sw: Niambie hesabu ikiwa na tofauti ya zaidi ya {value_limit}.

title.en: A large amount of stock was written off
title.sw: Kiasi kikubwa cha hisa kimeandikwa kama hasara

why.en: Large write-offs reduce your profit, and they may hide losses.
why.sw: Hasara kubwa hupunguza faida yako, na zinaweza kuficha upotevu.

todo.en: Check the reason given and look at the goods if you can.
todo.sw: Angalia sababu iliyotolewa na uone bidhaa kama inawezekana.

sentence.en: Tell me when a write-off is worth more than {value_limit}.
sentence.sw: Niambie hasara ya hisa ikiwa na thamani ya zaidi ya {value_limit}.

title.en: Stock is running low
title.sw: Bidhaa zinaisha

why.en: If it runs out, you lose sales while you wait for a delivery.
why.sw: Ikiisha, unapoteza mauzo ukisubiri bidhaa mpya.

todo.en: Order more of these products now.
todo.sw: Agiza bidhaa hizi zaidi sasa.

title.en: Stock shows less than zero
title.sw: Hisa inaonyesha chini ya sifuri

why.en: A delivery or transfer was probably not recorded, so stock figures are wrong.
why.sw: Huenda mzigo au uhamishaji haukuandikwa, kwa hiyo namba za hisa si sahihi.

todo.en: Record the missing delivery or do a stock count.
todo.sw: Andika mzigo uliokosekana au fanya hesabu ya hisa.

title.en: A product you sell has run out
title.sw: Bidhaa unayouza imeisha

why.en: Customers who cannot find it will buy elsewhere.
why.sw: Wateja wasiopata watanunua kwingine.

todo.en: Order it now, or move some from another branch.
todo.sw: Iagize sasa, au ihamishe kutoka tawi lingine.

sentence.en: Look at what sold in the last {days} days.
sentence.sw: Angalia kilichouzwa siku {days} zilizopita.

title.en: A lot of stock is being lost
title.sw: Bidhaa nyingi zinapotea

why.en: When too much is lost compared with what you handle, money is leaking away.
why.sw: Zikipotea nyingi sana ukilinganisha na unachoshughulikia, pesa zinavuja.

todo.en: Count the product, then look at who handles it and how it is stored.
todo.sw: Hesabu bidhaa, kisha angalia nani anaishughulikia na inavyohifadhiwa.

sentence.en: Tell me when more than {percent}% of a product is lost over {days} days.
sentence.sw: Niambie zaidi ya {percent}% ya bidhaa ikipotea ndani ya siku {days}.

title.en: Stock that has not sold for a long time
title.sw: Bidhaa ambazo hazijauzwa kwa muda mrefu

why.en: Money is stuck in goods that do not sell, and some may spoil or go out of date.
why.sw: Pesa zimekwama kwenye bidhaa zisizouzwa, na nyingine zinaweza kuharibika au kuisha muda.

todo.en: Consider a discount, a bundle or moving it to another branch.
todo.sw: Fikiria punguzo, kuuza pamoja na nyingine, au kuhamishia tawi lingine.

sentence.en: Tell me about stock worth {min_value} or more that has not sold for {days} days.
sentence.sw: Niambie kuhusu bidhaa za thamani ya {min_value} au zaidi ambazo hazijauzwa kwa siku {days}.

title.en: Stock sent to a branch has not arrived
title.sw: Bidhaa zilizotumwa tawini hazijafika

why.en: Goods may be lost on the way, or arrived and were never recorded.
why.sw: Bidhaa zinaweza kupotea njiani, au zimefika na hazikuandikwa.

todo.en: Call the receiving branch and record the delivery or find the goods.
todo.sw: Piga simu tawi linalopokea na uandike mzigo au utafute bidhaa.

sentence.en: Tell me when a transfer has not arrived after {days} days.
sentence.sw: Niambie uhamishaji ukiwa haujafika baada ya siku {days}.

title.en: Stock changed at odd hours or back-dated
title.sw: Hisa ilibadilishwa saa zisizo za kawaida au kwa tarehe ya zamani

why.en: Changes when the shop is closed or dated earlier can hide stock leaving unnoticed.
why.sw: Mabadiliko duka likiwa limefungwa au kwa tarehe ya nyuma yanaweza kuficha bidhaa kutoka bila kuonekana.

todo.en: Ask who made the change and why.
todo.sw: Uliza nani alifanya mabadiliko na kwa nini.

sentence.en: Tell me about stock changes outside {hours_from}:00 to {hours_to}:00, or dated {backdate_days}+ days earlier.
sentence.sw: Niambie kuhusu mabadiliko ya hisa nje ya saa {hours_from}:00 hadi {hours_to}:00, au yenye tarehe ya siku {backdate_days}+ nyuma.

title.en: A branch closed its day with the wrong cash
title.sw: Tawi limefunga siku na pesa isiyolingana

why.en: The money in hand does not match the sales, so cash may be missing or a sale was wrongly recorded.
why.sw: Pesa zilizopo hazilingani na mauzo, kwa hiyo pesa zinaweza kukosekana au mauzo yaliandikwa vibaya.

todo.en: Count the cash again and compare it with the day's sales.
todo.sw: Hesabu pesa tena na uzilinganishe na mauzo ya siku.

sentence.en: Tell me when the day's cash is out by more than {variance_limit}.
sentence.sw: Niambie pesa za siku zikiwa na tofauti ya zaidi ya {variance_limit}.

title.en: Many payment requests to customers' phones are failing
title.sw: Maombi mengi ya malipo kwa simu za wateja yanashindwa

why.en: Customers cannot pay and sales are lost. The payment service may have a fault.
why.sw: Wateja hawawezi kulipa na mauzo yanapotea. Huduma ya malipo inaweza kuwa na hitilafu.

todo.en: Check with your payment provider and take another payment method meanwhile.
todo.sw: Wasiliana na mtoa huduma wako wa malipo na upokee njia nyingine kwa sasa.

sentence.en: Tell me when {failure_percent}% or more of at least {min_attempts} requests fail.
sentence.sw: Niambie {failure_percent}% au zaidi ya maombi angalau {min_attempts} yakishindwa.

title.en: A large typed-in payment has no provider record
title.sw: Malipo makubwa yaliandikwa kwa mkono, hakuna rekodi kutoka kwa mtoa huduma

why.en: A payment that your provider has no record of may never have arrived.
why.sw: Malipo ambayo mtoa huduma hana rekodi nayo huenda hayakufika kamwe.

todo.en: Check your provider's statement. Ask the cashier for the payment message.
todo.sw: Angalia taarifa ya mtoa huduma. Mwombe keshia ujumbe wa malipo.

sentence.en: Tell me about typed-in payments over {amount_limit} with no provider record after {hours} hours.
sentence.sw: Niambie kuhusu malipo ya mkono yanayozidi {amount_limit} bila rekodi ya mtoa huduma baada ya saa {hours}.

title.en: A day has takings but was never closed
title.sw: Siku ina mapato lakini haikufungwa

why.en: Without a close, nobody has checked the day's cash against the sales.
why.sw: Bila kufunga siku, hakuna aliyelinganisha pesa za siku na mauzo.

todo.en: Ask the branch to count the cash and close the day.
todo.sw: Mwombe tawi lihesabu pesa na kufunga siku.

sentence.en: Tell me when a day is still not closed {grace_days} days after takings.
sentence.sw: Niambie siku ikiwa bado haijafungwa siku {grace_days} baada ya mapato.

title.en: The same payment may have been recorded twice
title.sw: Malipo yaleyale yanaweza kuwa yameandikwa mara mbili

why.en: A double payment makes your sales or cash look bigger than they are.
why.sw: Malipo mara mbili hufanya mauzo au pesa zako zionekane kubwa kuliko zilivyo.

todo.en: Look at both payments and cancel one if it is a copy.
todo.sw: Angalia malipo yote mawili na ufute moja kama ni nakala.

sentence.en: Tell me about equal payments from one payer within {window_minutes} minutes.
sentence.sw: Niambie kuhusu malipo sawa kutoka kwa mlipaji mmoja ndani ya dakika {window_minutes}.

title.en: A payment was undone after matching a sale
title.sw: Malipo yalifutwa baada ya kulinganishwa na mauzo

why.en: The customer may have paid nothing, even though the sale looks paid.
why.sw: Mteja huenda hakulipa chochote, ingawa mauzo yanaonekana yamelipwa.

todo.en: Check the sale and ask the customer to pay again if needed.
todo.sw: Angalia mauzo na umwombe mteja alipe tena kama inahitajika.

sentence.en: Look at payments undone in the last {days} days.
sentence.sw: Angalia malipo yaliyofutwa siku {days} zilizopita.

title.en: Money received differs from money banked
title.sw: Pesa zilizopokelewa hazilingani na zilizopelekwa benki

why.en: Some money may be held back, lost or charged as fees you did not expect.
why.sw: Pesa nyingine zinaweza kuzuiliwa, kupotea au kukatwa ada ambazo hukuzitarajia.

todo.en: Compare your provider's statement with your bank statement.
todo.sw: Linganisha taarifa ya mtoa huduma na taarifa ya benki.

sentence.en: Tell me when they differ by more than {tolerance_percent}% after {grace_days} days.
sentence.sw: Niambie zikitofautiana kwa zaidi ya {tolerance_percent}% baada ya siku {grace_days}.

title.en: Money came in with nothing to explain it
title.sw: Pesa zimeingia na hakuna kinachoeleza ni za nini

why.en: You cannot tell if it is a sale, a customer payment or a mistake.
why.sw: Huwezi kujua kama ni mauzo, malipo ya mteja au kosa.

todo.en: Find the payer and link the money to a sale or invoice.
todo.sw: Tafuta aliyetuma na uunganishe pesa hizo na mauzo au ankara.

sentence.en: Tell me when money is unlinked after {hours} hours.
sentence.sw: Niambie pesa zikiwa hazijaunganishwa baada ya saa {hours}.

title.en: Provider shows money matching none of your payments
title.sw: Mtoa huduma wako anaonyesha pesa ambazo hazilingani na malipo yako yoyote

why.en: Money may have arrived and not been recorded, so sales or customer accounts are wrong.
why.sw: Pesa zinaweza kuwa zimefika na hazikuandikwa, kwa hiyo mauzo au akaunti za wateja si sahihi.

todo.en: Find out who sent each one and record it against the right sale.
todo.sw: Tafuta nani alituma kila moja na uiandike kwenye mauzo sahihi.

sentence.en: Tell me when money has stayed unmatched for {unmatched_days} days.
sentence.sw: Niambie pesa zikikaa bila kulinganishwa kwa siku {unmatched_days}.

title.en: New person or pay change just before payroll
title.sw: Mtu mpya au badiliko la mshahara limetokea kabla tu ya malipo ya mishahara

why.en: Wages could be going to someone who should not be paid, or to the wrong account.
why.sw: Mishahara inaweza kwenda kwa mtu ambaye hapaswi kulipwa, au akaunti isiyo sahihi.

todo.en: Confirm the person and the new details are real before paying.
todo.sw: Hakikisha mtu huyo na maelezo mapya ni halisi kabla ya kulipa.

sentence.en: Look at changes made {days} days before payroll.
sentence.sw: Angalia mabadiliko yaliyofanywa siku {days} kabla ya malipo ya mishahara.

title.en: A leave request has waited too long
title.sw: Ombi la likizo limesubiri kwa muda mrefu

why.en: Your staff cannot plan, and may feel ignored.
why.sw: Wafanyakazi wako hawawezi kupanga, na wanaweza kuhisi hawajajaliwa.

todo.en: Approve or decline the request and tell the employee.
todo.sw: Idhinisha au kataa ombi na umjulishe mfanyakazi.

sentence.en: Tell me when a request has waited more than {days} days.
sentence.sw: Niambie ombi likisubiri zaidi ya siku {days}.

title.en: Someone was paid but has no attendance or leave
title.sw: Mtu amelipwa lakini hana rekodi ya kuhudhuria wala likizo

why.en: Wages may have been paid for work that was not done.
why.sw: Mshahara huenda umelipwa kwa kazi ambayo haikufanywa.

todo.en: Check with the manager that the person worked that period.
todo.sw: Thibitisha na meneja kwamba mtu huyo alifanya kazi kipindi hicho.

sentence.en: Tell me when most colleagues ({usage_pct}% or more) have records and one does not.
sentence.sw: Niambie wenzake wengi ({usage_pct}% au zaidi) wakiwa na rekodi na mmoja hana.

title.en: Someone's pay changed a lot with no reason shown
title.sw: Mshahara wa mtu umebadilika sana bila sababu inayoonekana

why.en: It may be a mistake in the payroll or a pay change nobody approved.
why.sw: Huenda ni kosa kwenye mishahara au badiliko la mshahara ambalo hakuna aliyeliidhinisha.

todo.en: Open the payslip and find out what changed before paying.
todo.sw: Fungua hati ya mshahara na ujue nini kimebadilika kabla ya kulipa.

sentence.en: Tell me when pay changes by {percent}% or more.
sentence.sw: Niambie mshahara ukibadilika kwa {percent}% au zaidi.

title.en: Someone approved a change to pay that they proposed
title.sw: Mtu ameidhinisha badiliko la mshahara alilopendekeza yeye mwenyewe

why.en: No second person checked it, so a pay rise or a change of account could be wrong.
why.sw: Hakuna mtu wa pili aliyeikagua, kwa hiyo nyongeza ya mshahara au akaunti mpya inaweza kuwa si sahihi.

todo.en: Ask another manager to review the change.
todo.sw: Mwombe meneja mwingine apitie badiliko hilo.

sentence.en: Look at pay changes from the last {lookback_days} days.
sentence.sw: Angalia mabadiliko ya mshahara ya siku {lookback_days} zilizopita.

title.en: Payroll is late and not finished
title.sw: Malipo ya mishahara yamechelewa na hayajakamilika

why.en: Staff are waiting for their wages, and late pay may upset them or break rules.
why.sw: Wafanyakazi wanasubiri mishahara yao, na kuchelewa kunaweza kuwakwaza au kukiuka sheria.

todo.en: Approve and pay the payroll today.
todo.sw: Idhinisha na ulipe mishahara leo.

sentence.en: Tell me when payroll is more than {days} days past its pay date.
sentence.sw: Niambie mishahara ikiwa imepita siku {days} baada ya tarehe ya malipo.

title.en: Someone worked far more overtime than usual
title.sw: Mtu amefanya saa za ziada nyingi kuliko kawaida

why.en: Extra hours cost money, and may be a mistake or a sign of too little staff.
why.sw: Saa za ziada zinagharimu pesa, na zinaweza kuwa kosa au ishara ya wafanyakazi kuwa wachache.

todo.en: Ask the manager if the hours were needed and approved.
todo.sw: Muulize meneja kama saa hizo zilihitajika na ziliidhinishwa.

sentence.en: Tell me about overtime of {min_hours} or more hours in the last {recent_days} days.
sentence.sw: Niambie kuhusu saa za ziada {min_hours} au zaidi katika siku {recent_days} zilizopita.

title.en: A branch sold far less than usual
title.sw: Tawi limeuza kidogo sana kuliko kawaida

why.en: Something may be wrong: stock out, a closed till, a quiet day or sales not recorded.
why.sw: Kuna kitu kinaweza kuwa kibaya: bidhaa zimeisha, kaunta imefungwa, siku tulivu au mauzo hayakuandikwa.

todo.en: Call the branch and ask what happened.
todo.sw: Piga simu tawi na uulize kilichotokea.

sentence.en: Tell me when a branch sells {drop_percent}% below its normal for that day.
sentence.sw: Niambie tawi likiuza chini ya kawaida ya siku hiyo kwa {drop_percent}%.

title.en: A cashier gave more discounts than usual
title.sw: Keshia ametoa punguzo nyingi kuliko kawaida

why.en: Too many discounts cut your profit. It may also be a habit worth looking at.
why.sw: Punguzo nyingi hupunguza faida yako. Pia inaweza kuwa tabia inayostahili kuangaliwa.

todo.en: Talk to the cashier and look at the discounted sales.
todo.sw: Zungumza na keshia na uangalie mauzo yenye punguzo.

sentence.en: Tell me when a cashier's discounts are above usual, judged over {days} days and at least {min_sales} sales.
sentence.sw: Niambie punguzo za keshia zikiwa juu ya kawaida, kwa siku {days} na mauzo angalau {min_sales}.

title.en: A cashier gave more refunds than usual
title.sw: Keshia amerejesha pesa nyingi kuliko kawaida

why.en: Refunds take money out of the till, so many of them are worth a look.
why.sw: Marejesho hutoa pesa kwenye kaunta, kwa hiyo mengi yanastahili kuangaliwa.

todo.en: Look at the refunded sales and ask the cashier about them.
todo.sw: Angalia mauzo yaliyorejeshwa na umuulize keshia.

sentence.en: Tell me when a cashier's refunds are above usual, judged over {days} days and at least {min_sales} sales.
sentence.sw: Niambie marejesho ya keshia yakiwa juu ya kawaida, kwa siku {days} na mauzo angalau {min_sales}.

title.en: A cashier cancelled more sales than usual
title.sw: Keshia amefuta mauzo mengi kuliko kawaida

why.en: Cancelled sales can hide money taken and not recorded, or simply be mistakes.
why.sw: Mauzo yaliyofutwa yanaweza kuficha pesa zilizochukuliwa bila kuandikwa, au kuwa makosa tu.

todo.en: Look at the cancelled sales and ask the cashier why.
todo.sw: Angalia mauzo yaliyofutwa na umuulize keshia kwa nini.

sentence.en: Tell me when a cashier's cancelled sales are above usual, judged over {days} days and at least {min_sales} sales.
sentence.sw: Niambie mauzo yaliyofutwa na keshia yakiwa juu ya kawaida, kwa siku {days} na mauzo angalau {min_sales}.

title.en: Credit given to a customer already late paying
title.sw: Mkopo umetolewa kwa mteja ambaye tayari alikuwa amechelewa kulipa

why.en: Selling more to someone who is not paying makes the unpaid amount bigger.
why.sw: Kumuuzia zaidi mtu asiyelipa kunaongeza deni ambalo halijalipwa.

todo.en: Ask the customer to pay the old amount before more credit.
todo.sw: Mwombe mteja alipe deni la zamani kabla ya mkopo mwingine.

sentence.en: Look at sales to customers late by more than {grace_days} days, and make it urgent at {high_days_overdue} days.
sentence.sw: Angalia mauzo kwa wateja waliochelewa zaidi ya siku {grace_days}, na iwe ya haraka siku {high_days_overdue}.

title.en: A customer owes more than their credit limit
title.sw: Mteja anadaiwa zaidi ya kikomo cha mkopo wake

why.en: The more they owe beyond the limit, the harder it is to collect.
why.sw: Kadiri wanavyodaiwa kupita kikomo, ndivyo inavyokuwa vigumu kukusanya.

todo.en: Ask the customer to pay before selling more on credit.
todo.sw: Mwombe mteja alipe kabla ya kumuuzia tena kwa mkopo.

sentence.en: Allow {tolerance_percent}% over the limit; make it urgent at {high_percent}%.
sentence.sw: Ruhusu {tolerance_percent}% juu ya kikomo; iwe ya haraka kwa {high_percent}%.

title.en: A customer is late paying
title.sw: Mteja amechelewa kulipa

why.en: The longer a bill stays unpaid, the less likely you are to be paid.
why.sw: Kadiri deni linavyokaa bila kulipwa, ndivyo uwezekano wa kulipwa unavyopungua.

todo.en: Call the customer and agree a payment date.
todo.sw: Mpigie mteja simu na mkubaliane tarehe ya kulipa.

sentence.en: Tell me when a customer is more than {min_days_overdue} days late, and urgent at {high_days_overdue} days.
sentence.sw: Niambie mteja akichelewa zaidi ya siku {min_days_overdue}, na iwe ya haraka siku {high_days_overdue}.

title.en: A customer is taking longer to pay
title.sw: Mteja anachukua muda mrefu zaidi kulipa

why.en: A customer who starts paying slower may be having money trouble.
why.sw: Mteja anayeanza kulipa polepole anaweza kuwa na matatizo ya pesa.

todo.en: Talk to the customer before the debt grows.
todo.sw: Zungumza na mteja kabla deni halijakua.

sentence.en: Tell me when a customer takes {increase_percent}% longer to pay than before.
sentence.sw: Niambie mteja akichukua muda mrefu zaidi kwa {increase_percent}% kulipa kuliko hapo awali.

title.en: A large cancelled sale, refund or price cut
title.sw: Mauzo makubwa yamefutwa, kurejeshwa au bei kupunguzwa

why.en: Big changes to a sale move a lot of money, so they should have a clear reason.
why.sw: Mabadiliko makubwa ya mauzo huhamisha pesa nyingi, kwa hiyo yanapaswa kuwa na sababu wazi.

todo.en: Look at the sale and ask the cashier or manager why.
todo.sw: Angalia mauzo na umuulize keshia au meneja kwa nini.

sentence.en: Tell me about a cancelled sale over {min_void}, a refund over {min_refund} or a price cut over {min_override}.
sentence.sw: Niambie kuhusu mauzo yaliyofutwa juu ya {min_void}, marejesho juu ya {min_refund} au punguzo la bei juu ya {min_override}.

title.en: Sales were entered days after they happened
title.sw: Mauzo yaliandikwa siku kadhaa baada ya kutokea

why.en: Late entries can hide mistakes or sales that were changed later.
why.sw: Rekodi za kuchelewa zinaweza kuficha makosa au mauzo yaliyobadilishwa baadaye.

todo.en: Ask why the sale was not entered on the day.
todo.sw: Uliza kwa nini mauzo hayakuandikwa siku yenyewe.

sentence.en: Tell me when a sale is entered {min_days_late} or more days late, and urgent at {high_days_late} days.
sentence.sw: Niambie mauzo yakiandikwa siku {min_days_late} au zaidi baadaye, na iwe ya haraka siku {high_days_late}.

title.en: Sales were made when the branch should be closed
title.sw: Mauzo yalifanywa wakati tawi linapaswa kuwa limefungwa

why.en: Sales outside working hours may be a login being used by someone else.
why.sw: Mauzo nje ya saa za kazi yanaweza kuwa jina la kuingia likitumiwa na mtu mwingine.

todo.en: Ask the branch who was at the till then.
todo.sw: Uliza tawi nani alikuwa kwenye kaunta wakati huo.

sentence.en: The branch is open from {open_hour}:00 to {close_hour}:00.
sentence.sw: Tawi hufunguliwa saa {open_hour}:00 hadi saa {close_hour}:00.

title.en: A till is out by more than usual
title.sw: Kaunta ina tofauti ya pesa kubwa kuliko kawaida

why.en: Missing cash may be a mistake in change given, or money taken.
why.sw: Pesa zinazokosekana zinaweza kuwa kosa la chenji, au pesa zilichukuliwa.

todo.en: Count the till again and ask the cashier.
todo.sw: Hesabu kaunta tena na umuulize keshia.

sentence.en: Warn me when a till is out by more than {limit}.
sentence.sw: Nionye kaunta ikiwa na tofauti ya zaidi ya {limit}.

title.en: A supplier invoice does not match what you ordered
title.sw: Ankara ya msambazaji hailingani na ulichoagiza

why.en: You may pay for goods you did not get or at the wrong price.
why.sw: Unaweza kulipa bidhaa ambazo hukupata au kwa bei isiyo sahihi.

todo.en: Check the invoice against your order and delivery, then fix or query it.
todo.sw: Linganisha ankara na oda na mzigo, kisha sahihisha au muulize msambazaji.

sentence.en: Tell me when an invoice mismatch has waited {waiting_days} days.
sentence.sw: Niambie tofauti ya ankara ikisubiri siku {waiting_days}.

title.en: A supplier bill may have been entered twice
title.sw: Ankara ya msambazaji huenda imeandikwa mara mbili

why.en: If both are paid, you pay the same bill twice.
why.sw: Zote mbili zikilipwa, unalipa ankara ileile mara mbili.

todo.en: Compare the two. Delete the copy before paying.
todo.sw: Zilinganishe. Futa nakala kabla ya kulipa.

sentence.en: Tell me about invoices with the same amount within {within_days} days.
sentence.sw: Niambie kuhusu ankara za kiasi kilekile ndani ya siku {within_days}.

title.en: A supplier may have been paid twice
title.sw: Msambazaji huenda amelipwa mara mbili

why.en: Paying twice is money out of your pocket.
why.sw: Kulipa mara mbili ni pesa kutoka mfukoni mwako.

todo.en: Check both payments and ask the supplier to refund one.
todo.sw: Angalia malipo yote mawili na umwombe msambazaji akurudishie moja.

sentence.en: Tell me about equal payments within {within_days} days.
sentence.sw: Niambie kuhusu malipo sawa ndani ya siku {within_days}.

title.en: A product costs more but price stayed same
title.sw: Bidhaa inagharimu zaidi lakini inauzwa kwa bei ileile

why.en: Your profit on it shrinks or disappears.
why.sw: Faida yako juu yake inapungua au kuisha.

todo.en: Raise the selling price or ask the supplier for a better price.
todo.sw: Ongeza bei ya kuuza au mwombe msambazaji bei nzuri zaidi.

sentence.en: Tell me when cost rises {cost_rise_percent}% and the margin falls below {min_margin_percent}%.
sentence.sw: Niambie gharama ikipanda kwa {cost_rise_percent}% na faida ikishuka chini ya {min_margin_percent}%.

title.en: An order costs more than this supplier charged before
title.sw: Oda ina bei ya juu kuliko msambazaji huyu alivyotoza awali

why.en: You may be about to overpay.
why.sw: Unaweza kuwa karibu kulipa zaidi ya inavyostahili.

todo.en: Ask the supplier why before confirming the order.
todo.sw: Muulize msambazaji kwa nini kabla ya kuthibitisha oda.

sentence.en: Tell me when an order price is more than {above_percent}% above the usual.
sentence.sw: Niambie bei ya oda ikizidi ile ya kawaida kwa {above_percent}%.

title.en: Supplier invoices are overdue
title.sw: Ankara za msambazaji zimechelewa kulipwa

why.en: Late payment can cost you trust, discounts or late fees.
why.sw: Kuchelewa kulipa kunaweza kukugharimu uaminifu, punguzo au ada za kuchelewa.

todo.en: Pay the oldest ones first, or agree a date with the supplier.
todo.sw: Lipa za zamani zaidi kwanza, au kubaliana tarehe na msambazaji.

sentence.en: Tell me when an invoice is {overdue_days} days overdue, and urgent at {serious_days} days.
sentence.sw: Niambie ankara ikichelewa siku {overdue_days}, na iwe ya haraka siku {serious_days}.

title.en: A supplier was paid for goods not received
title.sw: Ankara ya msambazaji ililipwa kwa bidhaa ambazo hukupokea

why.en: You paid for goods that never came, came short or were sent back.
why.sw: Ulilipa bidhaa ambazo hazikuja, zilikuja pungufu au zilirudishwa.

todo.en: Ask the supplier for a refund or the missing goods.
todo.sw: Mwombe msambazaji marejesho au bidhaa zilizokosekana.

sentence.en: Look at invoices paid in the last {days} days.
sentence.sw: Angalia ankara zilizolipwa siku {days} zilizopita.

title.en: A supplier's payment details were changed
title.sw: Maelezo ya malipo ya msambazaji yamebadilishwa

why.en: Changed bank details are a common way to send your money to the wrong person.
why.sw: Kubadilisha maelezo ya benki ni njia ya kawaida ya kupeleka pesa zako kwa mtu asiyestahili.

todo.en: Call the supplier on a number you already know to confirm the change.
todo.sw: Mpigie msambazaji kwa namba unayoijua tayari ili kuthibitisha mabadiliko.

sentence.en: Look at changes made in the last {days} days.
sentence.sw: Angalia mabadiliko ya siku {days} zilizopita.

title.en: A supplier raised the price of a product
title.sw: Msambazaji amepandisha bei ya bidhaa

why.en: Higher costs eat your profit unless you change your prices.
why.sw: Gharama kubwa zinakula faida yako usipobadilisha bei zako.

todo.en: Ask the supplier to explain it, and check your selling price.
todo.sw: Mwombe msambazaji aeleze, na uangalie bei yako ya kuuza.

sentence.en: Tell me when a price rises {rise_percent}% above earlier deliveries.
sentence.sw: Niambie bei ikipanda kwa {rise_percent}% juu ya mizigo ya awali.

title.en: Cash taken is more than cash banked
title.sw: Pesa zilizopokelewa ni nyingi kuliko zilizowekwa benki

why.en: Some takings may not have reached the bank.
why.sw: Baadhi ya mapato huenda hayajafika benki.

todo.en: Compare tills and bank deposits for each day and ask the branch.
todo.sw: Linganisha kaunta na pesa zilizowekwa benki kila siku na uulize tawi.

sentence.en: Tell me when over {tolerance_percent}% of cash sales (at least {min_gap}) is not banked after {grace_days} days.
sentence.sw: Niambie zaidi ya {tolerance_percent}% ya mauzo ya pesa taslimu (angalau {min_gap}) isipowekwa benki baada ya siku {grace_days}.

title.en: A payment may have been made twice
title.sw: Malipo huenda yamefanywa mara mbili

why.en: Paying the same person twice is money lost.
why.sw: Kumlipa mtu yuleyule mara mbili ni pesa iliyopotea.

todo.en: Check both payments and ask for one back.
todo.sw: Angalia malipo yote mawili na uombe moja irudishwe.

sentence.en: Tell me about equal payments to one person within {hours_apart} hours, over {min_amount}.
sentence.sw: Niambie kuhusu malipo sawa kwa mtu mmoja ndani ya saa {hours_apart}, juu ya {min_amount}.

title.en: A supplier invoice may have been entered twice
title.sw: Ankara ya msambazaji huenda imeandikwa mara mbili

why.en: If both are paid, the supplier gets paid twice.
why.sw: Zote zikilipwa, msambazaji analipwa mara mbili.

todo.en: Compare the two invoices and remove the copy.
todo.sw: Linganisha ankara hizo mbili na uondoe nakala.

sentence.en: Tell me about invoices of the same amount within {days_apart} days of each other.
sentence.sw: Niambie kuhusu ankara za kiasi kilekile zilizo ndani ya siku {days_apart} kati yake.

title.en: An expense is far above the usual
title.sw: Tumizi liko juu sana ya kawaida ya aina yake

why.en: It may be a mistake, a double entry or a cost to question.
why.sw: Linaweza kuwa kosa, rekodi mara mbili au gharama ya kuulizia.

todo.en: Check the receipt and ask what it was for.
todo.sw: Angalia risiti na uulize ilikuwa ya nini.

sentence.en: Tell me about expenses over {min_amount} that are much higher than usual.
sentence.sw: Niambie kuhusu matumizi yanayozidi {min_amount} na yaliyo juu sana ya kawaida.

title.en: A large sale was cancelled, refunded or discounted
title.sw: Mauzo makubwa yamefutwa, kurejeshwa au kupunguzwa bei

why.en: Big changes to a sale move a lot of money, so they need a clear reason.
why.sw: Mabadiliko makubwa ya mauzo huhamisha pesa nyingi, kwa hiyo yanahitaji sababu wazi.

todo.en: Look at the sale and ask who did it and why.
todo.sw: Angalia mauzo na uulize nani alifanya na kwa nini.

sentence.en: Tell me about a cancelled sale over {min_void}, a refund over {min_refund} or a discount over {min_discount}.
sentence.sw: Niambie kuhusu mauzo yaliyofutwa juu ya {min_void}, marejesho juu ya {min_refund} au punguzo juu ya {min_discount}.

title.en: A hand-made entry in the books looks odd
title.sw: Rekodi ya mkono kwenye hesabu inaonekana ya kushangaza

why.en: It may be large, round, made at night, back-dated or approved by its writer.
why.sw: Inaweza kuwa kubwa, ya namba ya pande zote, ya usiku, ya tarehe ya nyuma au imeidhinishwa na aliyeiandika.

todo.en: Ask who made it and check the papers behind it.
todo.sw: Uliza nani aliiandika na uangalie nyaraka zake.

sentence.en: Tell me about hand-made entries over {large_amount} or round amounts of {round_min} or more.
sentence.sw: Niambie kuhusu rekodi za mkono zinazozidi {large_amount} au za namba ya pande zote za {round_min} au zaidi.

title.en: A product shows less than zero in stock
title.sw: Bidhaa inaonyesha chini ya sifuri kwenye hisa

why.en: A delivery or opening count is probably missing.
why.sw: Huenda mzigo au hesabu ya mwanzo haijaandikwa.

todo.en: Record the missing delivery or count the product.
todo.sw: Andika mzigo uliokosekana au hesabu bidhaa.

sentence.en: Tell me when stock is below zero by {min_units} or more units.
sentence.sw: Niambie hisa ikiwa chini ya sifuri kwa vipande {min_units} au zaidi.

title.en: A new person was added to your other system
title.sw: Mtu mpya ameongezwa kwenye mfumo wako mwingine

why.en: A new login gives someone access to your business data.
why.sw: Jina jipya la kuingia humpa mtu ufikiaji wa taarifa za biashara yako.

todo.en: Check you know this person and that they need access.
todo.sw: Hakikisha unamjua mtu huyu na kwamba anahitaji ufikiaji.

sentence.en: Look at new people added in the last {days} days.
sentence.sw: Angalia watu wapya walioongezwa siku {days} zilizopita.

title.en: A sale marked paid electronically has no payment
title.sw: Mauzo yanasema yalilipwa kielektroniki, lakini hakuna malipo yanayoonekana

why.en: The customer may not have paid, or the sale was recorded with the wrong payment type.
why.sw: Mteja huenda hakulipa, au mauzo yaliandikwa na aina isiyo sahihi ya malipo.

todo.en: Check the statement for that sale and ask the cashier.
todo.sw: Angalia taarifa kwa mauzo hayo na umuulize keshia.

sentence.en: Tell me when a sale has no payment after {grace_hours} hours, and urgent at {high_count} sales.
sentence.sw: Niambie mauzo yakikosa malipo baada ya saa {grace_hours}, na iwe ya haraka kwa mauzo {high_count}.

title.en: A product keeps losing stock
title.sw: Bidhaa inaendelea kupoteza hisa

why.en: Repeated losses mean stock is leaking away.
why.sw: Hasara za mara kwa mara zinamaanisha bidhaa zinavuja.

todo.en: Count the product and see who handles it.
todo.sw: Hesabu bidhaa na uangalie nani anaishughulikia.

sentence.en: Tell me when a product loses at least {min_units} units or {min_loss} in {days} days.
sentence.sw: Niambie bidhaa ikipoteza angalau vipande {min_units} au {min_loss} ndani ya siku {days}.

title.en: A stock write-off or correction looks odd
title.sw: Hasara au marekebisho ya hisa yanaonekana ya kushangaza

why.en: It may be large, made at night or dated days earlier.
why.sw: Inaweza kuwa kubwa, ya usiku au ya tarehe ya siku kadhaa nyuma.

todo.en: Ask who made it and why.
todo.sw: Uliza nani alifanya na kwa nini.

sentence.en: Tell me about corrections worth {min_value} or more, or {min_quantity} units or more.
sentence.sw: Niambie kuhusu marekebisho ya thamani ya {min_value} au zaidi, au vipande {min_quantity} au zaidi.

title.en: A product costs more than it used to
title.sw: Bidhaa inagharimu zaidi kuliko zamani

why.en: Higher costs eat your profit unless you change your prices.
why.sw: Gharama kubwa zinakula faida yako usipobadilisha bei zako.

todo.en: Ask the supplier to explain, and check your selling price.
todo.sw: Mwombe msambazaji aeleze, na uangalie bei yako ya kuuza.

sentence.en: Tell me when the latest price is {rise_percent}% above the earlier average.
sentence.sw: Niambie bei ya mwisho ikizidi wastani wa awali kwa {rise_percent}%.

title.en: Money came in that matches no sale or invoice
title.sw: Pesa zimeingia ambazo hazilingani na mauzo wala ankara

why.en: You cannot tell what the money was for.
why.sw: Huwezi kujua pesa hizo zilikuwa za nini.

todo.en: Find who sent it and link it to the right sale.
todo.sw: Tafuta nani alituma na uiunganishe na mauzo sahihi.

sentence.en: Tell me about money over {min_amount} not matched after {grace_days} days.
sentence.sw: Niambie kuhusu pesa zinazozidi {min_amount} zisizolinganishwa baada ya siku {grace_days}.
